_comment: Known findings that are accepted rather than fixed. A waiver is keyed on (group, check)
and downgrades that check from FAIL so it cannot block CI. The finding is still printed
under WAIVED with its reason, and any NEW row appearing in the same check shows up in
that text, so a waiver hides the failure status but never the evidence.
Delete a waiver once the underlying data is fixed. Do not add one to make a red run
green without a reason someone can check.

waivers.reason: 2 known rows: J69U FY2024 Changi City Point (GR 2,666,000 vs NPI 3,134,000) and CY6U FY2025 CyberVale (GR 373,000,000 vs NPI 416,000,000 INR). Both need re-extraction against the source; the revenue figure looks partial. Remove this waiver once they are corrected.
